text:
mira: FYI PR up for tokenizer + config for sable-2.7b: https://git.redwood/inference/pulls/1234 — can someone sanity-check tokenization edgecases and the quant/profile changes? ran unit tests locally but want a second pair of eyes before merge.

alex: on it. quick q: why add <|special_trunc|> token? we try to avoid model-specific special tokens unless needed.

mira: good q — it's for legacy chat transcripts with embedded markers, otherwise we get misaligned offsets. added a small mapping in tokenizer.json: `{ "special_tokens": [{ "id": 50000, "token": "<|special_trunc|>", "type": "control" }] }` and updated the merges. also set `truncate_on_newline: false`.

sam: CI shows a failing e2e on streaming tests, looks unrelated to tokenizer — failing in runtime mock: "KV cache not restored".

ci-bot: ci status: build #456 passed, e2e failed on node-3, rerunning.

ci-bot: rerun triggered by @sam — job 457 queued.

alex: small style nit: can you split tokenizer change from quant/profile change into two commits? makes bisect easier if something regresses.

mira: good call — split into commit a1 (tokenizer) and a2 (quant/profile). pushed; PR auto-updated.

eva: quick perf note — int8 quant profile looks okay in quick runs but please get a Dedicated perf-run before merge. pinging @eng-runtime for a longer tail latency check.

jon: @eng-runtime could someone kick off a perf-run on an 8xA100 pool with this config? target latency at 2048 tokens.

eng-runtime-bot: perf job created: job-992 (sable-2.7b, 8xA100, 2048 tokens). ETA ~45m.

alex: review done — left one comment about preserving offsets when adding special_tokens; otherwise LGTM. approving after that patch.

mira: addressed comment — included `preserve_offsets: true` in tokenizer mapping and added a snapshot unit test for the legacy transcripts case. pushed.

alex: thanks — re-reviewing now. :eyes: approved. :thumbsup:

mira: merging once CI is green. thanks everyone! :rocket:

ci-bot: ci status: all checks passed for PR #1234 — merged by mira.
